details: Bitcoin (BTC) has surged past the $80,000 mark, with some reports indicating it reached as high as $81,490, exhibiting a gain of over 2-3% in the last 24 hours. This rally is partly attributed to significant spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, with one day seeing $630 million in net inflows, marking the highest monthly total of 2026. Furthermore, a White House advisor hinted at impending regulatory clarity for Bitcoin (Sector 160), which fueled market optimism. Institutional investors are showing strong demand, absorbing over 500% of the daily mined Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $80,000, ETF Inflows Boost Market

details: Cardano's ADA is showing a notable derivatives setup, with futures open interest surging over 18% to 2.17 billion tokens, surpassing its previous record set in January. This indicates strong buyer activity and aggressive market orders driving the price action.
title: Cardano (ADA) Futures Open Interest Reaches New Highs

details: TON, a top-performing altcoin, rallied over 28% in the past 24 hours following Pavel Durov's announcement that Telegram will replace the TON Foundation as the network's driving force. Futures open interest for TON has jumped 40% to a record 200.2 million tokens, with strong buying pressure.
title: TON Open Interest Jumps 40% After Telegram Announcement

details: An on-chain analyst detected a significant Ethereum transaction where an address transferred 6,200 ETH, valued at approximately $14.54 million, to Binance in the past 24 hours. The average deposit price was $2,346 per ETH, though the address still holds a substantial amount in Spark.
title: Ethereum Whale Transfers $14.54M ETH to Binance

details: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has declined to 40, shifting from a 'Neutral' stance last week to 'Fear'. This drop reflects increasing apprehension among investors in the cryptocurrency market.
title: Crypto Fear & Greed Index Drops to 40, Signals 'Fear'
